items.title: Custom user model
items.body:
# accounts/models.py
from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractUser
from django.db import models


class User(AbstractUser):
    phone = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True)

# settings.py
AUTH_USER_MODEL = "accounts.User"

# elsewhere: never import User directly
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
User = get_user_model()

items.title: select_related vs prefetch_related
items.body:
# ForeignKey / OneToOne  -> select_related (one SQL JOIN)
posts = Post.objects.select_related("author")

# reverse FK / ManyToMany -> prefetch_related (second query, joined in Python)
authors = Author.objects.prefetch_related("posts")

# Prefetch with a filtered queryset
from django.db.models import Prefetch
authors = Author.objects.prefetch_related(
    Prefetch("posts", queryset=Post.objects.filter(published=True), to_attr="live_posts")
)
items.description: Avoid N+1 queries: JOIN for single-valued relations, extra query for many.

items.title: Per-environment settings layout
items.body:
config/settings/
    __init__.py
    base.py     # shared settings
    dev.py      # from .base import *; DEBUG = True
    prod.py     # from .base import *; DEBUG = False; security settings

# choose one:
export DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.dev
python manage.py runserver --settings=config.settings.dev
items.description: Split settings into base, dev and prod modules.

items.title: Settings from environment variables
items.body:
import os

SECRET_KEY = os.environ["DJANGO_SECRET_KEY"]
DEBUG = os.environ.get("DJANGO_DEBUG", "0") == "1"
ALLOWED_HOSTS = os.environ.get("ALLOWED_HOSTS", "").split(",")
DATABASES = {
    "default": {
        "ENGINE": "django.db.backends.postgresql",
        "NAME": os.environ.get("DB_NAME", "app"),
        "USER": os.environ.get("DB_USER", "app"),
        "PASSWORD": os.environ["DB_PASSWORD"],
        "HOST": os.environ.get("DB_HOST", "localhost"),
        "PORT": os.environ.get("DB_PORT", "5432"),
    }
}
